title: Best OpenClaw Skills for Sales Teams: CRM Updates, Outreach, and Lead Research on Autopilot
summary: The OpenClaw skills that actually save sales teams time — from automated CRM updates to lead enrichment to outreach sequencing. Tested workflows, not theory.
body_markdown: Both options exist. Most sales teams start with draft-only (agent writes, human approves) and move to auto-send for specific use cases (follow-up sequences after no response for 72 hours) after trust is established. The human-in-the-loop approach reduces mistakes while the agent is being dialed in.
